name: Madala Holdings Limited
summary: Madala Holdings Limited provides information and technology services in India. The company offers document and data centric business process transformation solutions; enterprise application solutions; data transformation solutions; and tool assisted modernization solution. It also provides infrastructural facilities, such as leasing of properties and spaces. The company serves government, high tech, insurance, healthcare, media, and manufacturing industries. Madala Holdings Limited was formerly known as SoftSol India Limited and changed its name to Madala Holdings Limited in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
